profile.summary: Urban Ed Academy is a San Francisco nonprofit that works to increase the number of Black male educators in classrooms. Its Man the Bay fellowship recruits and prepares Black male educators and offers housing support and professional development. Its website says it works with schools in San Francisco and Oakland and that it planned to sunset operations on July 1, 2025.
